dogecoin.text: Haha... fatal flaw of crypto turns out to be lack of authority structure. Bitcoin has one but there's no rules about starting or BUYING newly issued crypto. The whole crypto mantra is so Utopian... which is always the precursor to a shit show. #dogecoin
